verdict.rationale: Jules has no documented native scheduler. Its public API lets users "create custom workflows" and "automate tasks like bug fixing and code reviews" with API keys, so recurring runs are only possible by driving the API from an external scheduler. That is extra tooling, and the docs never describe it. missing for 10: native scheduled/recurring task feature, documentation of cron-style or recurring triggers, hands-on evidence of anyone running Jules on a schedule.
